_comment: A thread the agent launches in a new worktree of its project (workspaceStrategy worktree, from main on a named branch): its run waits, preparing, while the server checks out main on that branch, then runs there and reports its worktree. Launches from a base that resolves to no commit, or onto a branch that exists, are refused before any thread is made.
